rules.evidence: The page owns the detailed modular-versus-frame comparison; the broad three-technology guide and commercial catalogues keep their separate intents.
The lead explains that frame is a structural scheme while modularity is a production and assembly format.
Definitions and technical context rely on current Rosstandart standard and code cards checked on 2026-10-02.
No universal prices, schedules, service-life figures, wall thicknesses or superiority claims are used.
The article links to both project catalogues and three relevant Journal guides.
Technical author and reviewer attribution to Oleg Ivanovich Kislyakov is approved by the site owner.
The CTA offers a site-specific comparison of both formats rather than pushing one universal solution.
Title, slug, excerpt, category, author, reviewer, SEO title and description are complete.
